turns.text:
I’ll use the inverse-design tool with your targets and bounds, then report the returned mix and its predicted performance.
The inverse-design search found candidates, but **none gives a reliable margin against both targets**. The lowest-clinker candidate uses 70% OPC and 30% limestone powder at w/b 0.302 and s/b 1.28. Its predicted 28-day strength is **48.1 [23.1, 63.7] MPa**, and its static yield stress is **0.954 [0.024, 3.840] kPa**. The estimated probability of satisfying both targets is **0.267**.

Static-yield predictions are guidance from a limited model (n=1,728; paper-grouped R²log=0.399). The search reports that candidate’s strength probability as 0.66, but its q10 is below 40 MPa; treat it as a candidate for experimental screening, not a demonstrated design. The retrieved exact literature analogues use different binder compositions, so they do not directly validate this OPC–limestone candidate.
